verdict.rationale: Customer.io's automations are rule-based workflows with defined triggers, goals, exit criteria and workflows, and they can fire automatically when profiles perform events or join segments. For AI-native users, the official MCP server lets an AI tool create and manage these automations through natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that AI-created, event-triggered automations work as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can trigger automations when profiles perform events, when they join Segments (e.g. they meet attribute conditions), and so on.
It consists of four major components: Trigger... Goals... Exit criteria... Workflows

With the MCP server, you can do just about anything you can do in Customer.io via your AI tool of choice—read workspace data, create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and more—all through natural language prompts.
An automation is a workflow to send messages and manipulate data in Customer.io.
